flags.message: gemini-baseline's retrieval.md states 'No retrieval beyond the provisioned inputs' and its reasoning says no web retrieval was performed, but its harness-captured retrieval_log.json carries two shell rows invoking `fedcourts query --disposition granted` with a topical phrase (results unobserved, capture coverage 0.0). The queries sought prior granted cases, not this docket, so this is a disclosure gap and not leakage; noted so the predictor-side retrieval note can be checked against the log on future cells.
